items.title: Reminder: US non-farm payrolls will be on the data docket this week
items.summary: And it doesn't come any bigger than the US jobs report. To be fair, perhaps the US CPI report will be of more importance. However, don't underestimate the potential for any surprises in labour market data to upend the market pricing on the Fed outlook.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
items.summaryZh: 而没有什么比美国就业报告更重大的了。公平地说，或许美国CPI报告的重要性会更高一些。不过，不要低估劳动力市场数据中任何意外情况颠覆市场对美联储前景预期定价的可能性。
items.summaryEn: And it doesn't come any bigger than the US jobs report. To be fair, perhaps the US CPI report will be of more importance. However, don't underestimate the potential for any surprises in labour market data to upend the market pricing on the Fed outlook.
